tools.name: search_references
tools.description:
Search license-normalized reference material (image / video / audio / text) across the configured sources. Every result carries a license id + canonical source link. Pass `intent` to annotate each result with a use-verdict (may I use this, is attribution required) WITHOUT filtering; pass `gateFor` to instead return only results whose license allows that intent. Results are references, not rights clearance — not legal advice.

Configured sources:
- openverse (image): Aggregated openly licensed images from many sources (Openverse)
- openverse-audio (audio·music,sound-effect): Aggregated openly licensed music and sound effects (Openverse)
- wikimedia-commons (image): Freely licensed media from the Wikimedia Commons archive
- met (image·artwork): Open Access artworks from the Metropolitan Museum of Art
- artic (image·artwork): CC0 artworks from the Art Institute of Chicago
- gutendex (text·ebook): Public-domain ebooks from Project Gutenberg (Gutendex)
- poetrydb (text·poem): Classic public-domain poetry (PoetryDB)
- rijksmuseum (image·artwork): Rijksmuseum collection artworks, incl. the Dutch Golden Age
- polyhaven (image·texture): CC0 PBR textures for 3D work (Poly Haven)
- ambientcg (image·texture): CC0 PBR materials and textures (ambientCG)
- internet-archive (video/text·film,ebook): Public-domain and CC films and texts from the Internet Archive
- nailbook (image·photo): Japanese nail-art design photos (Nailbook)

query.description: what to search for, e.g. "cyberpunk alley at night"

sources.description: restrict the search to specific sources by id (omit to search every configured source — see "Configured sources" in this tool description). Use to scope a search-engine operator (e.g. "site:example.com") to a web-discovery source without affecting other sources' queries.

controls.description: provider-neutral search controls; providers translate supported controls and report ignored controls in explain metadata

providerOptions.description: provider-specific search controls keyed by provider id; each provider whitelists supported keys

explain.description: include provider status, applied and ignored controls, warnings, gate/drop metadata, and the load-more cursor

cursor.description: opaque cursor from a previous result's nextCursor — fetches the next batch, deduped against earlier batches

rerank.description: re-rank results by query relevance (term coverage incl. CJK over title/description/tags/excerpt, fused cross-source relevance, resolution, source and near-duplicate diversity). Default true — pass false for raw cross-source rank fusion. true cannot re-enable reranking when the host built the client with rerank: false

minRelevance.description: drop results the ranker scored below this, after reranking. Graded against the reranker's blended score, where a result matching no query term lands around 0.3 under the stock weights — so 0.5 keeps only real matches. Off by default (a bar can empty the batch). Does NOT transfer to rerank: false, where raw fusion is max-normalised and the top result is always 1

deadlineMs.description: whole-search deadline in ms, cursor page advances included (unlike the host's per-source timeout, which bounds one source search). Sources still in flight when it fires are reported as failed and the rest are returned; a hard bound while the host leaves per-source resilience on (the default), and otherwise only binding on sources that honour the abort signal

gateContext.description: context for the `gateFor` gate, matching the evaluate_use tool's jurisdiction inputs

userJurisdiction.description: caller's jurisdiction; a mismatch with a source-declared one defaults to needs-review

intent.description: annotate each result with a use-verdict for this intended use (no filtering)

gateFor.description: only return results whose license allows this intended use

tools.name: evaluate_use
tools.description: Stateless license/use-gate check: given a license id + intended use, returns a conservative-heuristic verdict (allowed / allowed-with-attribution / denied / needs-review) with reasons and confidence. Not legal advice — a strict-deny heuristic over source-declared license facts.

licenseVersion.description: precise CC version, e.g. "4.0" — attribution only

canonicalUrl.description: canonical source link, for attribution and audit

intent.description: the intended use to evaluate this license against

jurisdiction.description: source-declared jurisdiction of the PD/copyright status

userJurisdiction.description: caller's jurisdiction; mismatched jurisdictions default to needs-review

tools.name: build_attribution
tools.description: Mechanically derive an attribution credit line (plain text + HTML) from a license id + author + title + canonicalUrl. `required` is false when the license needs no attribution (e.g. CC0, PD).

licenseVersion.description: precise CC version, e.g. "4.0" — appended to the license name
